last.verdict: Stock slipped as huge AI spending drained cash, outweighing record margins and faster AWS growth.

reasons.label: Cash turned deeply negative
reasons.text: Free cash flow was an outflow of $42.4B over twelve months, versus +$14.8B a year ago.

reasons.label: Sales growth slowed
reasons.text: Sales grew 12% to $201.9B; shifted Prime Day timing cut about 4 points of growth.

reasons.label: AWS and margins strong
reasons.text: AWS grew 39% and operating margin hit a record 13.9%, cushioning the drop.

story: AWS growth has sped up from 37% last quarter to 39%, and profit margins keep rising. The worry has shifted to spending: about $220B of capex this year has pushed free cash flow negative. The stock jumped 15.3% last time but slipped this time.

history.verdict: Investors cheered AWS's fastest growth in 18 quarters and big profit gains.

reasons.label: AWS speeds up
reasons.text: Cloud sales grew 37%, the fastest in 18 quarters, and AI and chip businesses each topped $25B yearly.

reasons.label: Profit jumps
reasons.text: Operating income rose 43% to $27.5B; AWS profit grew from $10.2B to $16.6B.

reasons.label: Spending seen as paying off
reasons.text: Yearly spending plan rose to about $220B, but investors accepted it given AWS's $496B backlog.
